issues.finding: TimeSage-EV corpus is described as 1,485 instances over 24 periods; source says at least 24 per scenario and Feb 2023–May 2026.
issues.replacement: The reported snapshot contains 60 scenarios across six domains and 1,485 scenario-period instances spanning February 2023 to May 2026.

issues.finding: Lifecycle combines construction, learning/updating, evaluation, operational use, while caption allows any dedicated treatment. A cross may hide dedicated partial coverage. Root is independently source-checking this table.
issues.replacement: Define each retained column with one observable organizing criterion; encode unverified full-text cells as not coded, not absence. If Lifecycle remains, state exactly which linked stages qualify and retain per-cell source locators.

issues.finding: Three adapted overview captions identify only an RSI-style survey template, with no bibliographic source or figure number. This is not a complete attribution.
issues.replacement: Replace the vague last sentence with an actual verified work title/citation and source figure number, e.g. Visual organization adapted from [verified reference], Fig. X; content and hierarchy developed for this survey.
issues.action: resolve actual source from figure manifest; do not guess citation

issues.finding: Detailed TSEvol paragraph appears among TSK synthesis procedures although the contribution is LLM-specific instruction supervision. Existing Section3 cross-reference helps but source of scope ambiguity remains.
issues.replacement: For language-model supervision, ChatAD \citep{chatad2026} constructs temporal instruction dialogues through TSEvol; this model-side use of synthesis is discussed in Section~3.
issues.action: shorten here; move role detail to LLM instruction subsection if retained

issues.finding: Section2 repeats scenario-first construction after the grid example and then again enumerates it; final roadmap repeats Section1 organization. These are coherent but consume space better used for comparison.
issues.replacement: Let the five-step list carry the construction procedure. Delete the immediately preceding paragraph beginning The construction begins with the scenario, and condense the closing roadmap to a single forward link to Sections3–7.

issues.finding: Unified notation includes omega_k, M_tau and C_task which are not used as common variables in main-text equations. This suggests a unified formalism beyond what methods actually share.
issues.replacement: Keep symbols used across equations (x, t/tau/H, admissible information, state/action/observation, outputs); define method-specific symbols beside their equations. Remove unused typed-tool-call and memory notation unless actually used.

issues.finding: Focused ChatTS and ModernTSF cases are prospective design sketches, not empirical system case studies; headings already say analyses but much content repeats Sections3/7.
issues.replacement: Rename subsection Design implications and retain one precise comparison per case: numerical representation interface for ChatTS, experience state for TimeClaw, fixed numerical substrate for ModernTSF. Avoid repeating pipeline descriptions.

issues.finding: TimeClaw formula attribution is correct. The external state A_s is task-scoped in source; current phrase transferable result may be read too broadly when paired with cross-task reuse rhetoric.
issues.replacement: The cleaned evidence updates the task-scoped experience state $A_s$. The update mechanism accepts different task losses; transfer of the retained content is assessed on held-out episodes.
issues.action: clarify state scope; no change to GH mechanism classification

issues.finding: TimeSage-EV and its next-period skill activation provides has subject–verb mismatch.
issues.replacement: TimeSage-EV \citep{timesageev2026} provides a concrete availability rule through next-period skill activation.

issues.finding: This criterion follows the temporal contracts emphasized in cited surveys may attribute the authors own GH/GTS boundary directly to prior taxonomies.
issues.replacement: We use these temporal requirements to distinguish shared temporal modules from general runtime mechanisms, building on the task and reasoning perspectives in \citep{chen2026tsagentsurvey,changsurvey2026}.
issues.action: separate synthesis criterion from source taxonomy
